verdict.rationale: Creating vault entries programmatically is a fair question for an authenticator vault, so the axis applies. The evidence only shows QR-code capture inside the app and a developer-facing Authy API/SDK for services adding 2FA to their own apps, not for users seeding or updating their own vault. That API is also closed to new customers per Twilio's deprecation notice. Community reports describe no export path and only hacky debug-mode extraction, with no documented user-facing API for vault writes.
